intake.what: Fixes long part descriptions overflowing the line on the printed invoice PDF. No new settings, no new screens. Customers noticed it on invoices with more than 12 line items.

expect.note: A bug fix should land as a quiet release with release notes and a help article, not a launch.

intake.what: Lets a shop sell and bill recurring maintenance plans: a customer picks a plan, visits get scheduled automatically each season, invoices go out on the plan's cycle, and the dispatcher sees which customers are on a plan when a call comes in. Billed as a percentage of plan revenue collected through Halden.
intake.asked_by: Our CEO after the board meeting, plus 40% of accounts in the last NPS survey

expect.note: Recurring revenue for the customer and a take rate for Halden is a major launch; the brief must name the pricing risk.

intake.what: Technicians attach photos to a work order from the mobile app and tag them before, during or after. Office staff see them on the invoice preview. Available on Pro and above.
intake.asked_by: Six customers in the forum thread about disputes over completed work

expect.note: A tier gated convenience feature is standard, and the Starter segment must be addressed.
